Equipment.Presenting: PC with keyboard (keys m/n, match key depends on keyMode right/left)

Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 20 practice trials (accuracy >= 80% required to proceed, per paper)
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 216 experimental trials (3 matching combinations x 36 + 6 nonmatching combinations x 18)

Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 500 ms judgement window (program p.judgeTime; exact deadline not stated in paper)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Geometric shapes (stimulus files Associate1-3.bmp; user-verified 2026-08-30: Associate1 = triangle, Associate2 = square, Associate3 = circle). Identity binding fixed per program (shape code i paired with label code i): triangle = you (self), square = friend, circle = stranger.
Stimulus_Properties.Label: English words: you, friend, stranger (you_EN/friend_EN/stranger_EN.bmp)

Colors.Stimulus: Black (fgColor [120 120 120] set but shapes/text rendered dark)

exp1.detail: Experiment 1 training phase (associative-learning task = matching task stored here). 3 identities: you/friend/stranger (label codes 1/2/3 per program Associate_shape.m; shapes user-verified: 1=triangle=you, 2=square=friend, 3=circle=stranger; matching combinations (1,1)(2,2)(3,3) x 36, nonmatching 6 combinations x 18; 2 blocks x 108 trials; keys m (nonmatch)/n (match), match key 2 for keyMode=right else 1; RespKey 0 = no response). Shape/Label columns store the actual stimuli (shape names / label words you-friend-stranger), numeric codes kept in ShapeCode/LabelCode and the Origin identity columns. Data: 43 participant .mat files x 216 trials (paper: 46 tested, 4 excluded for poor catch-trial performance -> 42 analyzed; database keeps all 43 with data, N=43). RT in ms (0 = no response -> NA). No demographics in .mat (paper: 33 females, M age 19.69 +- 1.98). Paper reports the matching task as associative-learning validation (self-advantage); SPE direction verified in the database. Ethics: Anhui Medical University. Source: paper full text (Wiley HTML) + data and procedure.zip; [P] paper, [D] data, [C] code.
